dod_intent_evidence: DoD intent is not in doubt — ONR SBIR Phase IIs (Osiris, FMS), an OSD Phase II Enhancement, DARPA definitive contract HR001123C0007, IARPA Phase 3 and Video LINCS, and a JAIC $241M BOA (SBIR section + News) — but the company type disqualifies it.
score_evidence: Dropped as a government R&D services contractor, not a product company facing a prototype-to-field transition. Their public offer is a capability roster, not a product: "Our Skills: Signal Processing / Computer Vision / Deep Learning / Web Development / Cloud and DevOps / Embedded Systems" (homepage).

"As teams, we design, develop, and deliver innovative, advanced signal, image, and multi-INT solutions ... to solve our customers' most complex, demanding, and urgent C4ISR challenges" — customer-funded solution delivery, the definition of services-only (about-us).

"Research Based: We actively perform applied research to advance the state of the art" plus "See some of our published papers, conference talks, and tutorials" — publications, not products, are the showcase (homepage).

Headline metrics are "Active Projects" and "Total Projects"; DARPA contract HR001123C0007 is NAICS 541715 (R&D in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences) — a portfolio-of-projects business (homepage + News).

126 employees, founded 2013, holding a $241M JAIC ordering vehicle and an IARPA Phase 3 — far outside the $5M-$10M band, and no single transition is existential to them, which is the inverse of Barry's EDP.
what_they_do: 126-person Herndon defense/IC contract R&D house building AI/ML signal, image and multi-INT capability for DARPA, IARPA, ONR and OSD programs.
